# Queue theory

> Queue theory (queueing theory) for software teams: notation, utilization, Little’s law, Kingman’s formula, Erlang C, service metrics, DORA metrics, and practical insights. Source: https://github.com/queue-theory/queue-theory

- [Activity tracking](https://queue-theory.github.io/en-001/#activity-tracking)
- [Service metrics](https://queue-theory.github.io/en-001/#service-metrics)
